news.title: SpaceX要求压低IPO承销费率 但投行仍有望分食5亿美元收入
news.detail: 马斯克旗下SpaceX正在与经手其IPO的华尔街投行谈判，希望支付极低的费率。不过，即便收费标准大幅压低，负责此次上市的银行仍有望从这场创纪录的IPO中获得约5亿美元收入。

news.title: SpaceX力求压低IPO费率 投行仍有望斩获约5亿美元佣金
news.detail: 埃隆・马斯克旗下SpaceX正洽谈以极低费率，委托华尔街投行承办IPO上市事宜，但各家投行仍有望从这场创纪录的首发募资中斩获约5亿美元佣金。

news.title: Anthropic秘密递交IPO申请 估值9650亿美元挑战万亿市值
news.detail: AI行业或将迎来史上最大规模IPO。当地时间6月1日，人工智能初创公司Anthropic宣布已秘密向美国证券交易委员会提交S-1注册声明草案，正式启动上市筹备流程。

news.title: Victoria Secret shares spike 40% after big earnings beat, raised sales outlook
news.detail: Victoria's Secret has been in the midst of a turnaround under CEO Hillary Super, who said the company is winning over young shoppers across all incomes.

news.title: Nvidia's new PC chips represent CEO Huang's bid to win at every layer of AI stack
news.detail: Nvidia's announced entry into the PC chip market sent shares of AMD, Intel and Qualcomm lower as Wall Street recognized the threat.

news.title: Alphabet plans to raise $80 billion from stock sales to fund AI build-out
news.detail: Alphabet said it plans to sell $80 billion in stock, including through a $10 billion investment by Berkshire Hathaway.

news.title: 欧元区5月通胀率升至3.2% 能源价格飙涨10.9% 欧央行6月加息几成定局
news.detail: 欧盟统计局6月2日公布的初步数据显示，2026年5月欧元区消费者物价指数同比上涨3.2%，高于4月的3.0%，创下自2023年9月以来的最高水平，且连续第四个月上升。

news.title: HPE surges 25% after blowout earnings, pacing for its best day ever
news.detail: Shares of Hewlett Packard Enterprise surged 27% Tuesday morning, pacing its biggest daily gain ever as the company posted its biggest earnings beat since 2018.

news.title: SpaceX正就IPO承销费进行谈判，希望费率低于0.75%
news.detail: 马斯克旗下的SpaceX正与承销其首次公开募股（IPO）的银行进行谈判，希望就其本月计划筹集的约750亿美元支付低于0.75%的承销费。
